# Differential test vectors - vehicle engine (Team D, original game as oracle)

Companion data for `spec-differential-results.md` (round 5, D-17 / D-18). Engine values are the shipped vehicle table fields; "expected" is the original executable's output (emulated) with every extra multiplier at 1 and no damage penalty; "Team B" is the rebuilt engine torque at snapshot 7436a78 for the same engine RPM and throttle.
